svg.title: Multus CNI architecture diagram
svg.desc: Shows how Multus sits between the CRI runtime and delegate CNI plugins, with NAD CRD and Pod netns components

g.text: GET Pod annotation → GET NAD → build delegates → exec in order
PATCH network-status → return delegate[0].Result to CRI

svg.text: 按顺序 fork-exec，每个 delegate 操作同一个 netns
pause 进程通过 OCI spec linux.namespaces[network].path 由 runc setns() 加入此 netns
